payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the supplied image, does the edit show visible progress toward a pencil-drawn style, without clearly establishing a completed pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Pass when comparison establishes a visible stylistic change toward pencil-like linework or shading, even if substantial photographic appearance remains. Muted color or grain alone is insufficient. Fail when the image is unchanged or changes are unrelated to the requested style. Unknown when comparison is unavailable or the direction of stylistic change cannot be determined.
node.binding: Compare the edited image with the supplied source only to assess progress toward the requested pencil-drawing transformation; unrelated edits do not count. Assess this independently of whether the endpoint check can be determined.
